data.title: Preview: Red Bull Salzburg vs Ararat-Armenia - prediction, team news, lineups - Sports Mole
data.content:
Having not come into contention until after the October international break, 39-cap Austria international Stefan Lainer is also pushing for an opportunity, while Karim Konate is likely to start down the middle of the attack.

Ararat-Armenia goalkeeper Joao Bravim is suspended for this contest. However, having been an early injury withdrawal against Van, Arman Nersesyan was expected to deputise regardless. [...] Sandro Lima could get the nod over Arayik Eloyan down the middle of the attack, reward for his goal as a substitute in the last league game.

Although defensive-minded midfielder Karen Muradyan also netted as a substitute during that contest, he may remain among the replacements.

Red Bull Salzburg possible starting lineup:

Zawieschitzy; Morgalla, Drexler, Zabransky, Kratzig; Barry, Diabate; Lindstrom, Mazurek, Vertessen; Konate

Ararat-Armenia possible starting lineup: [...] Nersesyan; Hovhannisyan, Felipe, Malis, Pereira; Ayvazyan, Oliveira; Banjaqui, Ambartsumyan, Franca; Lima

## We say: Red Bull Salzburg 3-1 Ararat-Armenia

Although the visitors have little option but to push for all three points in Austria, they may struggle to get hold of the ball. With that in mind, we are backing a comfortable victory for RB Salzburg, who we think will edge closer to qualification for the knockout phase.
